tool.name: IMAGINE-X subhkl Shared Storage Cleanup
tool.description: Remove superseded SubHKL shared-filesystem intermediates on a worker node

configfiles.configfile:
#raw import sys from subhkl.io.shared_storage import cleanup_shared_artifact
if_ephem = str(sys.argv[1]).strip().lower() in ("true", "1", "yes") raw_net = sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else "" ptr_arg = sys.argv[3] if len(sys.argv) > 3 else ""
targets = [s.strip() for s in raw_net.split(",") if s.strip()] if ptr_arg.strip(): targets.append(ptr_arg.strip())
removed = 0 for tgt in targets: if cleanup_shared_artifact(tgt, only_if_delete_after_use=if_ephem): print(f"[subhkl] Deleted shared intermediate for '{tgt}'", flush=True) removed += 1
print( f"[subhkl] Shared cleanup worker finished ({removed}/{len(targets)} removed).", flush=True, ) #end raw

tool.command: umask 0000 && export CUDA_CACHE_PATH=/tmp/cuda_cache XDG_CACHE_HOME=/tmp/xdg_cache XDG_CONFIG_HOME=/tmp/xdg_config && export SUBHKL_SHARED_DIR="\${SUBHKL_SHARED_DIR:-/gpfs/neutronsfs/scratch/subhkl_shared}" HDF5_USE_FILE_LOCKING=FALSE && export JAX_PLATFORMS=cpu XLA_PYTHON_CLIENT_PREALLOCATE=false && #set $ptr_path = "" #if $pointer: ln -sf "$pointer" pointer_input.json && #set $ptr_path = "pointer_input.json" #end if python -u "$cleanup_script" "$ifEphemeral" '$networkPath' "$ptr_path" > "$output" 2>&1

param.name: ifEphemeral
param.label: Only delete pointer targets marked delete_after_use=true

tool.help: Lightweight CPU worker utility that deletes superseded `subhkl_shared_<uuid>_*.h5` intermediates from `SUBHKL_SHARED_DIR` when the interactive UI container mounts `SUBHKL_SHARED_DIR` read-only (`ro`).
